queries.label: Count frames containing front-right wheel speed
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM {{table}} WHERE WHEEL_SPEED_FR IS NOT NULL

queries.label: Count front-right wheel speeds at least 100km/h
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM {{table}} WHERE WHEEL_SPEED_FR >= 100.0

queries.label: Count wheel-speed frames for one segment in a one-second window
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM {{table}} WHERE WHEEL_SPEED_FR IS NOT NULL AND source_file={{window_source}} AND ts >= {{window_start}} AND ts < {{window_end}}

queries.label: Count, average, minimum and maximum wheel speed
queries.sql: SELECT count(WHEEL_SPEED_FR) AS n, avg(WHEEL_SPEED_FR) AS average, min(WHEEL_SPEED_FR) AS minimum, max(WHEEL_SPEED_FR) AS maximum FROM {{table}}

queries.label: Sum products of front-left and front-right wheel speeds
Ratio of product sum to rear-right wheel-speed sum
Maximum minus minimum front-right wheel speed
Ratio of sums for one segment in a one-second window
queries.sql: SELECT sum(WHEEL_SPEED_FR*WHEEL_SPEED_FL)/nullif(sum(WHEEL_SPEED_RR),0)*100 AS value FROM {{table}} WHERE source_file={{window_source}} AND ts >= {{window_start}} AND ts < {{window_end}}

queries.label: Top five segments by wheel-speed frame count
queries.sql: SELECT source_file, count(*) AS n FROM {{table}} WHERE WHEEL_SPEED_FR IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_file ORDER BY n DESC, source_file LIMIT 5

queries.label: Project the first 20 wheel-speed frames
queries.sql: SELECT source_file, ts, WHEEL_SPEED_FR, WHEEL_SPEED_FL FROM {{table}} WHERE WHEEL_SPEED_FR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source_file, ts, WHEEL_SPEED_FR, WHEEL_SPEED_FL LIMIT 20
